persistence: Live individual/cohort SLA projections are computed from accepted indexed inputs for an explicit as_of_utc. Beta 1.0 does not make a mutable cache row authoritative because active elapsed time changes with the canonical clock. Completed report snapshots are persisted separately in schema/reporting.json.

rules: unclassified and missing Report Date are independent states
Cancelled preserves chronology but has no cohort tier result
one SR may have several tier results for its severity

cohort_key.rule: compliance state/outcome is never part of identity

rules: active_exceeded is already impossible to meet the current tier absent later correction/suspension evidence
is_final requires calendar month closed at as_of and zero active cohort members
Final Met requires is_final and terminal_met percentage meets configured threshold
final failure uses Breached rather than inventing Final Failed enum

warning_projection.rule: warning condition keys are stable derived identifiers for LLD-11/LLD-12 presentation/deduplication; LLD-06 does not turn warnings into lifecycle facts

cache_rule: If implementation later adds a local performance cache within Beta 1.0, every cache row must bind exact as_of/input_fingerprint and be safely discardable/rebuildable. Cache absence/staleness must never alter result correctness.
